spanish: Y ardió nariz de Jehová en ellos, y anduvo.

findings.issue: Morphology is an affirmation particle (HTa), while lemma/Strong’s H639 leaves a noun open; «nariz» selects the anatomical noun and makes it the subject of ardió, so Jehová becomes only a possessor.

notes: Verbs, Jehová, בָּם, and וַיֵּלַךְ match the remaining tokens.
